name: editor-selection-highlight
title: Fix CodeMirror mouse selection highlight
description: Fix edit-page mouse selection highlight by overriding CodeMirror 6 drawSelection overlay backgrounds with a dedicated theme token and sufficient selector specificity.
creator: hbw
notes: Root cause: CodeMirror basicSetup enables drawSelection(), so visible selection is .cm-selectionLayer .cm-selectionBackground, not native ::selection. The focused override must beat CodeMirror's light/dark base-theme selector.

verification: runtime DOM check: .cm-selectionBackground computed background matched --cm-selection-bg
